brief_summary: to assess the effect of treatment with Sitagliptin (MK0431) on HbA1c (Hemoglobin A1c) and the safety and tolerability of Sitagliptin.
brief_title: The Effect of Sitagliptin in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus With Inadequate Glycemic Control (MK0431-118)

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients Who Are 18 Years Of Age With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus Who Are Either:

  * Not On Antihyperglycemic (AHa) Medication (Off For At Least 2 Months)
  * Or On A Single AHa

official_title: Open-label, Non Placebo-Controlled Study To Verify the Effect of Sitagliptin In Adult Patients With Type 2 Diabetes and Inadequate Glycemic Control

primary_outcomes.measure: Change From Baseline in HbA1c (Hemoglobin A1c) at Week 18
